creator: Fisher, R. (1936)
changes: None; exact official file bytes preserved. Program selects setosa sepal lengths in centimeters.
split: Use original 1-based within-setosa row numbers divisible by 5 as held-out data: 10 held out, remaining 40 train.
limitations: Reproducible teaching split; historical row order is not randomization and does not establish independent representative sampling. Normal distribution is a scoped approximation with negative-length support. UCI documents feature corrections in other columns; this exercise does not alter the original file.
